arguments.content:
"""Extract text content from a .pptx file using markitdown and save to markdown."""
import sys
from markitdown import MarkItDown

src = sys.argv[1]
dst = sys.argv[2]

md = MarkItDown()
result = md.convert(src)
with open(dst, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(result.text_content)
print(result.text_content)

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ascii"?>
<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main" xmlns:m="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/math" xmlns:a14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/drawing/2010/main" showMasterSp="1" showMasterPhAnim="1">
  <p:cSld>
    <p:spTree>
      <p:nvGrpSpPr>
        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>
        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>
        <p:nvPr/>
      </p:nvGrpSpPr>
      <p:grpSpPr>
        <a:xfrm>
          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>
          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>
        </a:xfrm>
      </p:grpSpPr>
      <p:sp>
        <p:nvSpPr>
          <p:cNvPr id="94" name="Title 1"/>
          <p:cNvSpPr txBox="1"/>
          <p:nvPr>
            <p:ph type="ctrTitle"/>
          </p:nvPr>
        </p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr>
          <a:prstGeom prst="rect">
            <a:avLst/>
          </a:prstGeom>
        </p:spPr>
        <p:txBody>
          <a:bodyPr/>
          <a:lstStyle/>
          <a:p>
            <a:pPr defTabSz="242315">
              <a:defRPr sz="2332"/>
            </a:pPr>
            <a:r>
              <a:t>Thank you for your attention</a:t>
            </a:r>
          </a:p>
        </p:txBody>
      </p:sp>
    </p:spTree>
  </p:cSld>
  <p:clrMapOvr>
    <a:masterClrMapping/>
  </p:clrMapOvr>
  <p:transition xmlns:p14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main" spd="med" advClick="1"/>
</p:sld>

"""Register the new final slide (slide6) in package parts and back up the original file."""
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

unpacked = Path("unpacked")

# Back up the original file before it gets overwritten at pack time
orig = Path("Q4_financial_report.pptx")
backup = Path("Q4_financial_report.backup.pptx")
if orig.exists() and not backup.exists():
    shutil.copy2(orig, backup)
    print(f"Backed up original to {backup}")

# 1. [Content_Types].xml: add Override for /ppt/slides/slide6.xml
ct = unpacked / "[Content_Types].xml"
text = ct.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
anchor = '<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>'
assert anchor in text, "slide5 override anchor not found in [Content_Types].xml"
assert 'PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml"' not in text, "slide6 override already present"
addition = anchor + '\n  <Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>'
ct.write_text(text.replace(anchor, addition, 1), encoding="utf-8")

# 2. ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels: add relationship rId13 -> slides/slide6.xml
rels = unpacked / "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"
text = rels.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
anchor = '<Relationship Id="rId12" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide5.xml"/>'
assert anchor in text, "rId12 anchor not found in presentation.xml.rels"
assert 'Target="slides/slide6.xml"' not in text, "slide6 relationship already present"
addition = anchor + '\n  <Relationship Id="rId13" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide6.xml"/>'
rels.write_text(text.replace(anchor, addition, 1), encoding="utf-8")

# 3. ppt/presentation.xml: add slide id 261 to the sldIdLst (end of list)
pres = unpacked / "ppt/presentation.xml"
text = pres.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
anchor = '<p:sldId id="260" r:id="rId12"/>'
assert anchor in text, "sldId 260 anchor not found in presentation.xml"
assert 'r:id="rId13"' not in text, "slide 261 already present in presentation.xml"
addition = anchor + '\n    <p:sldId id="261" r:id="rId13"/>'
pres.write_text(text.replace(anchor, addition, 1), encoding="utf-8")

print("Registered slide6 in [Content_Types].xml, presentation.xml.rels, and presentation.xml")
